newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts office retailers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts office retailers.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it started coverage of Staples Inc with an outperform rating based on its announced merger with Office Depot Inc.
-- Said Office Depot was also started as outperform.
-- Estimates Staples will generate 30-35 percent earnings per share growth for the next three years, with 1995 earnings estimated at $0.92 per share.
-- Said Staples shares should move into mid-20's over the next year.
-- Also started coverage of OfficeMax Inc with an outperform rating, with a 12-month price target of $18 per share.
OfficeMax shares rose 1-3/8 to 14-1/2. Office Depot rose 19/32 to 20-3/4 and Staples gained 1/8 to 18-7/8.
